correctness.rationale: Fix the distinct existential witness values U (u≤k) and their t≤u marked equivalence classes. Outside U there are t+1 incidence profiles. A model of order 2k+2 has >t+1 outside points and hence two with the same profile. Its induced witness-plus-pair substructure satisfies all universal clauses; replacing the pair by any number of clones realizes exactly the same two-variable atomic types and still defines an equivalence relation. This constructs every order n≥k+2. The explicit k marked two-point classes plus at most one unmarked singleton establishes the upper ceiling 2k+1 and all finite sharp sizes. k=0 is covered separately.

value.rationale: In a natural partition/equivalence model class the best possible endpoint drops exponentially in k compared with arbitrary binary graph relations: from k+2^k to 2k+1. The exact model-size cutoff and explicit witness theories give a finite test for whether a two-universal equivalence theory has infinitely many finite models. This is a meaningful structural refinement of model-spectrum theory, not a mere variable renaming or numerical experiment.
